name: Sonata
description: Soloist with accompaniment: one violin lead over piano and a low-string floor. Clarity above everything — the soloist owns the line, the accompaniment stays out of the way, and the piano answers in the violin's rests (call and response) instead of playing through them. Budget: at most 3 concurrent layers, energy clamp [0.15, 0.65]; the ceiling is a hard constraint, the floor is a soft directive. Octave doubling is forbidden — the solo line must not be blurred. Every role is a track the app already has.
